questions.q: Most of Earth's surface is covered by ocean.
questions.note: Oceans cover about 70% of our planet.

questions.q: Whales are a type of fish.
questions.note: Whales are mammals that breathe air.

questions.q: Sharks have a skeleton made of cartilage.
questions.note: Cartilage is the same flexible stuff in your ears.

questions.q: Male seahorses are the ones that give birth.
questions.note: Dad carries the eggs and delivers the babies.

questions.q: Jellyfish are older than the dinosaurs.
questions.note: They have drifted in the sea for 500+ million years.
